template: On the Repair Desk app (already signed in), open the ticket titled '{{v1}}' (reference {{v3}}, url #/tickets/{{v4}}, currently status {{v5}}). Two things to do: (1) delete both parts — '{{v6}}' and '{{v7}}' — using each row's Delete action (confirm any confirmation dialog). (2) Then archive the ticket — find the archive action (it may be a button on the ticket detail or in the list; discover it). reportTemplate.summary: Deleted both parts on {{v3}} — each row's Delete opened an in-page "Confirm" dialog with a "Delete part" button (no native browser dialog), which I confirmed; after each refresh the row disappeared, leaving the detail page showing "No parts on this ticket yet." Then I clicked the detail page's "Archive ticket" button: the app accepted it with no error or confirmation prompt, the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket", and the status block reads "Status / {{v5}} / Archived". Verification on the list: the default (active) view dropped from 14 to 13 tickets ("Showing 1–10 of 13"), starting at RD-1014, and searching {{v3}} with "Show archived" unchecked returns "No tickets match the current filters." — so it is hidden from the active list. Ticking "Show archived" surfaces the row "{{v3}}  {{v1}} Archived  Not recorded  {{v5}}  0  2026-09-15", i.e. 0 parts and archived.
